cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA983, from Los Angeles to Beijing, DABMA 30, level 9800m, SABEM 45, contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是CCA（国航）983，飞机从洛杉矶飞往北京，DABMA 30分，高度9800米，SABEM 45分，联系北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, from Los Angeles to Beijing, DABMA 30, maintaining 9800m, SABEM 45.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航983，洛杉矶飞往北京，DABMA 30分，9800米保持，SABEM 45分。

cards.audioText: CCA983, Beijing Control, confirm squawk 1230.[Your squawk is 1232.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，北京区调，证实应答机1230。【你的应答机编码是1232。】
收到，国航983，应答机1232, 雷达看到。

cards.audioText: [You are experiencing severe turbulence, request descent to low level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在经历严重颠簸，请求下降到低高度层。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983. We are experiencing severe turbulence, request descent to low level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航983，我们正在经历严重颠簸，请求下降到低高度层。

cards.audioText: CCA983, what is the detailed ride condition?[Tell the ATC the turbulence is caused by cumulonimbus.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，穿越颠簸状态如何？【告诉ATC颠簸是由积雨云引起的。】
cards.referenceText: The turbulence is caused by cumulonimbus, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 颠簸是由积雨云引起的，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, thanks.[Report to the controller that you have been struck by lightning.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，谢谢。【报告管制员飞机遭受了雷击。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, we have been struck by lightning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航983，我们遭受雷击。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, confirm your operations are normal?[Tell the controller that flight is smooth, but the main power doesn’t work, now you are using the auxiliary power supply.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，证实能够正常飞行？ 【告诉管制员飞行操作顺畅，但是主电源不工作，现在你正在使用辅助电源。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, flight is smooth, but the main power doesn’t work, we are using the auxiliary power supply now, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，飞行操作顺畅，失去主电源，我们现在正在使用辅助电源，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, any other problem?[There is something wrong with the navigation system, ask ATC to monitor you closely.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，还有其它问题吗？【导航系统出现问题，向ATC请求密切监控。】
cards.referenceText: Our navigation system is out of action, please keep a close eye on us, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的导航系统不工作，请对我们进行密切监控，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, where did the lightning strike you?[Only the left hand windshield was struck, others are all normal.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，雷击在飞机哪个部位？【只有左边挡风玻璃遭受雷击，其它部位全部正常。】
cards.referenceText: Lightning hit us above the left hand windshield, zero damage, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击在左挡风玻璃，无损伤，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, say intention.[Request priority landing at Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，说明意图。【请求优先着陆在北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing at Beijing airport, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先着陆北京机场，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger. Turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m. Expect runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到。左转直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，预计跑道01。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m. Expect runway 01, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞HUR，下降并保持3600，预计跑道01，国航983。

cards.audioText: [You want to know the weather condition at Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你想知道北京机场的天气情况。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, advise weather condition at Beijing airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航983，请告知北京机场的天气情况。

cards.audioText: CCA983, weather is clearing except for a little ice on the runway, expect a visual approach runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，天气晴朗，但跑道有少量冰，预计目视进近跑道01。
cards.referenceTextZh: 目视进近，跑道01，谢谢，国航983。

cards.audioText: [As a passenger was bruised on the head during the turbulence, request medical service on arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【因为机上有一位乘客在颠簸中擦伤头部，请求到达时的医疗服务。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA983, request medical service on arrival as a passenger was hurt during the turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航983，请求到达时医疗服务，一位乘客在颠簸中受伤。

cards.audioText: CCA983, medical services will be ready on arrival.[You have established localizer, contact Beijing Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，医疗服务将在到达后就位。【你已经建立好航向道，联系北京塔台。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航983，已建立好航向道。

cards.audioText: CCA983, cleared to land runway 01, runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor, use caution.[Readback and ask the tower whether the preceding aircraft can land normally.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，允许着陆跑道01，跑道被冰覆盖，刹车效应差，务必谨慎。【复诵并向塔台询问前面的飞机是否能正常着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 01, braking action poor, did the preceding aircraft land normally? CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 允许着陆跑道01，刹车效应差，前机能正常着陆吗？国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, all preceding aircraft had normal landings, standing ice is not that serious.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983, 之前的所有飞机都已经正常着陆，积冰不是非常严重。
